exit 0
--- stdout
Ask the live runner to end its batch. Within seconds it stops starting work,
kills the commands and bisect steps running then, records them not run, and
keeps every result already finished. The batch ends aborted
(aborted_by_operator) and is not retried at the same HEAD without run --force;
the integration gate reports deferred_validation_aborted until a merge or a
forced run. Refused when no runner holds the lock.
Usage:
liza deferred-validation abort [flags]
Flags:
-h, --help help for abort
--json output result as structured JSON
--ruling string decision that authorizes this change
Global Flags:
--check-update check for a Liza update before running
-C, --project-root string Liza project root for state commands
--update-channel string update check channel: stable or main (default "stable")
-v, --verbose verbose output
--- stderr
